decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Floette plus Manectric pressures the expected Pelipper + Mega Swampert rain lead immediately: Thunderbolt threatens Pelipper while Energy Ball threatens Swampert, and Lightning Rod discourages Water attacks into Manectric. Hatterene provides a Trick Room reversal option, while Scrafty brings Intimidate and useful physical-pressure control for Swampert and Basculegion.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favored Pelipper + Mega Swampert rain with Basculegion and Whimsicott in Game 1. Pelipper: Damp Rock Drizzle, Hurricane/Hydro Pump/Protect/Tailwind. Mega Swampert: Adamant, Swift Swim, Earthquake/Waterfall/Ice Punch/Protect. Whimsicott: Prankster Focus Sash, Tailwind/Encore/Moonblast/Protect. Basculegion: Adamant Choice Scarf Adaptability, Last Respects/Wave Crash/Flip Turn/Aqua Jet; Wave Crash locks it. Mega Floette's Energy Ball and Fairy Aura-boosted Fairy attacks are strong into this composition; prioritize Pelipper and Mega Swampert, respect Whimsicott Sash/Tailwind and Scarf Basculegion endgames.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper and Swampert form a core rain-setting and sweeping duo with Drizzle and Mega Swampert, while Basculegion and Primarina provide strong backline cleaning and adapt to the opponent's aggressive Tailwind / Electric options.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 lead: Pelipper + Swampert, with Basculegion and Primarina in the back. Opponent brought Talonflame, Manectric, Hatterene, and Floette-Eternal in Game 1.

decisions.rationale: Mega Energy Ball pressures the rain-enabled Mega Swampert slot while Life Orb Thunderbolt guarantees Pelipper's KO if it does not Protect.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's established rain core is Damp Rock Drizzle Pelipper plus Adamant Mega Swampert with Swift Swim; likely backline includes Prankster Focus Sash Whimsicott and Choice Scarf Adaptability Basculegion. Preserve answers to Tailwind and Scarf Basculegion endgames.

decisions.rationale: Bring Hatterene to retain Trick Room as the strongest answer to the opponent’s Tailwind and likely fast rain backline; Floette can protect while Hatterene establishes speed control.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s rain lead is Damp Rock Drizzle Pelipper plus Adamant Mega Swampert. Likely backline includes Prankster Focus Sash Whimsicott and Choice Scarf Adaptability Basculegion. Preserve Trick Room and Fake Out/Snarl options to answer Tailwind and Scarf rain endgames.

selection: Earthquake (all adjacent, including ally Pelipper) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Setting Tailwind with Pelipper and Mega Evolving Swampert to use Earthquake threatens both opposing slots while doubling our Speed under Swift Swim next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: opponent brought Floette-Eternal, Manectric, Talonflame, Hatterene.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper stays in to maintain rain or attack while Basculegion enters to clean up with Choice Scarf Adaptability Wave Crash or Last Respects under rain and Tailwind, outspeeding the remaining opponent threats.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Basculegion is a strong late-game cleaner with choice scarf in rain.

decisions.rationale: Protect Hatterene from Basculegion’s rain-boosted Wave Crash, which is a guaranteed KO, while Energy Ball pressures Basculegion and sets up Scrafty’s Fake Out to create a later Trick Room window.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has used Damp Rock Drizzle Pelipper, Adamant Mega Swampert, and Choice Scarf Adaptability Basculegion; prioritize preserving Hatterene for Trick Room and use Scrafty’s Intimidate/Fake Out to create setup turns against their rain-speed control.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Floette-Mega is at 37% HP and can be KOed by Pelipper's Hydro Pump or Basculegion's Wave Crash. Targeting Floette with Hydro Pump and Hatterene with Last Respects secures an immediate KO on Floette while heavily damaging or eliminating Hatterene.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Scrafty)
decisions.rationale: Fake Out removes Pelipper’s attack this turn, allowing Hatterene to safely establish Trick Room through Basculegion’s nonlethal, Choice-locked Last Respects. Trick Room then lets Hatterene and Scrafty act before the scarfed Basculegion next turn.
decisions.notebook: Basculegion is Choice Scarf Adaptability and revealed a Last Respects lock; at -1 Attack, its Last Respects does not OHKO full Hatterene. Pelipper carries Damp Rock Drizzle and Tailwind. Preserve Hatterene to reverse rain-speed control with Trick Room, using Scrafty Fake Out to deny the opposing partner's damage on setup turns.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper uses Hurricane on Scrafty (super-effective), while Choice Scarf Basculegion uses Last Respects on Hatterene (super-effective). Tailwind is still active on our side, and Basculegion outspeeds both remaining foes to pick up clean KOs in the rain.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Basculegion with Choice Scarf in rain under Tailwind is our primary cleaner; Pelipper supports with Hurricanes into Scrafty.

decisions.rationale: Snarl is the only line that meaningfully reduces Pelipper's repeated special damage while also chipping both foes; Basculegion is locked into its weak resisted Last Respects.

Scrafty is the sole remaining active opponent and is weak to Flying; Pelipper hits it with Hurricane. Basculegion is locked into Last Respects, which hits Scrafty for neutral/halved damage, but since Scrafty is the only target remaining (and Last Respects hits the only opposing slot) Basculegion uses Last Respects into Scrafty. Tailwind expires at the end of this turn, so finishing Scrafty now closes out the game cleanly.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Basculegion and Pelipper clean up Scrafty with Tailwind active in rain.

decisions.rationale: Knock Off into Basculegion is Scrafty’s only available line with a possible immediate KO and removes its Choice Scarf if it survives.
decisions.notebook: Basculegion is Choice Scarf Adaptability and was locked into Last Respects; Pelipper has Damp Rock Drizzle and Tailwind. Against rain speed control, preserve Hatterene where possible and use Fake Out support to enable Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper's Hurricane cleanly KOs the remaining Scrafty, and Basculegion can use Last Respects just in case or as a safe follow-up.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 won cleanly with Pelipper and Basculegion finishing off Scrafty.

reflections.summary: The four brought were reasonable into rain: Mega Floette cleanly removed Mega Swampert, and Hatterene/Scrafty offered a Trick Room route. Mega Floette was an appropriate evolution for Swampert, but the opening trade left it exposed to Choice Scarf Basculegion's increasingly powerful Last Respects; Basculegion then prevented Hatterene from establishing Trick Room and rain Pelipper finished the endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, prioritize getting Trick Room up before trading away Floette: use Scrafty's Fake Out pressure to create a safer Hatterene Trick Room turn, while preserving Floette as a late-game Fairy attacker rather than leaving it available for Basculegion's Last Respects.
reflections.notebook: Basculegion is Adamant Choice Scarf Adaptability and can repeatedly use Last Respects; it was locked into that move. Pelipper is Modest Damp Rock Drizzle with Tailwind, Hydro Pump, Hurricane, and Protect. Mega Swampert is Adamant with Earthquake, Waterfall, Ice Punch, and Protect. Against this rain speed-control core, preserve Hatterene where possible and use Scrafty Fake Out support to enable Trick Room; avoid exposing Floette to Basculegion before Trick Room is established.

reflections.summary: Swampert and Pelipper opened with immediate pressure against Manectric and Mega Floette, setting up Tailwind and pivoting into Choice Scarf Basculegion to clean up with high-power Last Respects once Trick Room setter Hatterene went down.
reflections.adjustment: Maintain aggressive positioning against Trick Room threats and ensure Basculegion keeps clear paths to spam Last Respects safely.
reflections.notebook: Opponent uses Manectric, Mega Floette, Hatterene, Scrafty, Talonflame, and Goodra-Hisui. Floette Mega Evolves into Fairy Aura, Manectric carries Life Orb and LightningRod, Hatterene carries Sitrus Berry and Magic Bounce, and Scrafty carries Roseli Berry and Intimidate.
